April 15, 1994

TO: Mr. A. Sadovnick

FROM: J. Schnepf

SUBJECT: HARLEY DAVIDSON -- LONG RANGE GOALS

Now that the Harley brand has been in the market place for approximately five months, I have had the opportunity to evaluate the support programs in place. There are some long range goals which I would recommend to be considered for the success of this brand.

The recommended goals are as follows:

A. Establishment of an image based campaign

The name Harley currently denotes it's own image and that should be to Lorillard's advantage. We do not have to establish a new image but we must capitalize on the image that has existed for years.
Currently our image portrayed is one of price discount. Price should be a trial device and not the on-going reason for consumer to smoke or try this product.

An image related campaign capitalizing on the Harley name is needed and should be supported with the appropriate promotional opportunities.

94306159
